paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: table : figure
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the GSM8K accuracy of a system under two conditions—“No Delay” and “Delay”—as a function of the cache ratio, which ranges from 0.2 to 0.5 on a linear scale along the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “GSM8K Accuracy,” spans from 0 to 80 in increments of 20, also on a linear scale. The “No Delay” condition is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a sharp decline in accuracy from approximately 70 at a cache ratio of 0.2 to about 5 at a cache ratio of 0.5. The “Delay” condition is depicted by a solid gray line with square markers, which remains relatively stable, hovering around 75 to 78 across the entire range of cache ratios. The legend is positioned in the lower-left corner of the plot, clearly distinguishing the two conditions.
